prompt: Design a premium social-media advertisement for ZipPilot, a shared neighborhood direct-mail service. Brand style: deep navy blue background (#0A1E3C), bright blue (#2F80ED) and vivid green (#5BC236) accents, clean modern sans-serif typography, high contrast, professional advertising quality. Include the provided ZipPilot logo mark (blue location pin with a house and green growth arrow) at the top with the wordmark 'ZipPilot' shown with 'Zip' in white and 'Pilot' in bright blue. All text must be spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible.  Vertical portrait format. Layout: photorealistic golden-hour scene of a smiling homeowner standing at a curbside mailbox holding a large navy postcard with a colorful grid of local business ads, suburban street with soft bokeh behind. Headline in bold white: '10,000 neighbors are about to meet your business.' Subheadline in light blue: 'Be on the next ZipPilot card in your ZIP code.' Bottom: green pill button 'Reserve Your Spot' and URL 'TheZipPilot.com' in white.
